newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rate falls slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rate falls slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 728-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.14 percentage points to 1.54 percent above the one-month Cetes rate at Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.69837 pesos.
Demand for the bondes was 3.85 billion pesos, compared with the 700 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
